policy_rate.label: Central Bank of Iceland key rate, seven-day term deposits (BIS central bank policy rates, M.IS, from June 2014)

debt_gdp.label: General government gross debt, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

deficit.label: General government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP (IMF WEO)

current_account.label: Current account balance, % of GDP (World Bank)

fdi.label: FDI net inflows, % of GDP (World Bank)

exports.label: Exports of goods, FOB, krónur (Statistics Iceland external trade from January 2011; 2006 to 2010 from the IMF's US$ figures converted at the BIS monthly average rate)

imports.label: Imports of goods, CIF, krónur (Statistics Iceland external trade from January 2011; 2006 to 2010 from the IMF's US$ figures converted at the BIS monthly average rate)

trade_balance.label: Trade balance, goods, exports FOB less imports CIF, krónur (Statistics Iceland from January 2011; 2006 to 2010 from the IMF's US$ figures converted at the BIS monthly average rate)

gdp_level.label: GDP, current prices, seasonally adjusted (Statistics Iceland via OECD quarterly national accounts, T0102)

gdp_real.label: Real GDP, chain-linked volume, seasonally adjusted (Statistics Iceland via OECD, T0102)

gdp_growth.label: Real GDP growth, change on previous quarter, seasonally adjusted (Statistics Iceland via OECD, T0102)

gdp_growth_yoy.label: Real GDP growth, change on same quarter a year earlier, seasonally adjusted (Statistics Iceland via OECD, T0102)

unemployment.label: Unemployment rate, 15+, seasonally adjusted, monthly (Statistics Iceland labour force survey via OECD)

cpi.label: CPI, all items, change on same month a year earlier, from Statistics Iceland's all-items index (via OECD)

cpi_mom.label: CPI, all items, change on previous month, not seasonally adjusted, from Statistics Iceland's all-items index (via OECD)
